biggest_catch: The $250 is forfeited entirely if the account is closed before it has been open for 6 months, and all three requirements (Digital Banking, eStatements, $400+/mo recurring direct deposit) must be completed within 120 days with three full months of deposits credited.
catches: NEW members only; existing members and existing eChecking holders are excluded.
Recurring direct deposit must be at least $400 per month and be payroll/direct deposit (not just any transfer); three full months must credit before the bonus qualifies.
Digital Banking enrollment, eStatement enrollment, and direct deposit establishment must ALL happen within 120 days of account opening.
Account defaults to Personal Checking without notice if eStatement enrollment is not completed.
Bonus is forfeited if the account is closed before it has been open 6 months.
eChecking does not accrue dividends; a $2 monthly paper statement fee applies if eStatements are not used.
One bonus per member; programs and offers are subject to change without notice (no fixed end date).

steps: As a new member (membership requires a Share Account with $0.01 par value; account and membership subject to approval), apply for a new eChecking account at ccu.com/echecking-offer/ (online, branch, or phone (800) 334-8788) and fund a minimum opening deposit of $25 (page instructs depositing at least $251 after approval).
Within 120 days of account opening, enroll in Digital Banking and enroll in eStatements.
Within 120 days of account opening, establish a recurring Direct Deposit (payroll/direct deposit) of at least $400 per month into the eChecking account.
Receive three (3) full months of recurring direct deposits credited to the account.
Keep the account open for a minimum of 6 months; the $250 bonus is added the first week of the month following the qualifying date.
